title: Locally Private Estimation of CATE Variance under Rough Regression Functions

gap_reasons: The delivered full-class brackets match NI/SI risk and honest length only at beta=1; the advertised rough-confounding frontier remains unresolved in risk-frontier and honest-frontier. proof_attempt_summary: Discovery established original-record private full-class finite risk/length brackets, honest coverage, consistency, a matched beta=1 sequential endpoint, and a balanced-prior small-information comparison. The all-beta sharp NI/SI frontier did not close: rates, critical logarithms, interaction regions, and sharp interval lengths remain open; the independent validity gate found no bounded faithful repair. Banked downgraded at incremental under the standing field floor before formalization; no Lean proof or acceptance is claimed.
tldr: Centered CATE variance summarizes observable treatment-effect dispersion without identifying individual-effect variance. Under once-per-record pure local privacy, this note proves finite full-class NI/SI risk and globally honest connected-interval brackets, consistency exactly when \(M=n\epsilon^2\) tends to infinity, a normalized small-information comparison for a legal cubic moment-matching family, and matching \(M^{-1}\) risk and \(M^{-1/2}\) length for both protocol classes at \(\beta=1\). For \(0<\beta<1\), sharp rates, critical logarithms, any interaction region, the parametric elbow, and a two-sided risk--length comparison remain open.
gap: Private quadratic density estimation and smooth functional synthesis do not currently furnish a verified complete theorem for this rough marked-ratio functional with public-coin NI channels, adaptive SI histories and finite honest lengths.
fill: A complete numerical risk and length characterization, lawful attaining collection protocols, and converses over every allowed mechanism determine the cost of rough unknown confounding without presuming an interaction advantage.
